snippet.title: Every Wednesday - Official Reveal Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Every Wednesday, a 2.5D narrative-driven adventure novel developed by Pixel Chest Storyworks. Players will follow Hideki by exploring the laundromat, build connections, and uncover the stories of those around you. Every Wednesday is coming soon to PC (Steam).
